name: Kubernetes
description: How Kubernetes runs, connects and configures your workloads.

chapters.title: Pods & Workloads
chapters.topic: Kubernetes pods and workload controllers: pod lifecycle and phases, init and sidecar containers, probes (liveness, readiness, startup), Deployments and rolling updates, ReplicaSets, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs and CronJobs, resource requests and limits, QoS classes.

chapters.title: Services & Networking
chapters.topic: Kubernetes networking: the pod network model, Services (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, headless), kube-proxy and endpoints/EndpointSlices, DNS and service discovery, Ingress and the Gateway API, NetworkPolicies, debugging connectivity.

chapters.title: Config, Secrets & Storage
chapters.topic: Kubernetes configuration and storage: ConfigMaps and Secrets (env vs mounted files, updates, encryption at rest), Volumes, PersistentVolumes and PersistentVolumeClaims, StorageClasses and dynamic provisioning, access modes, StatefulSet volume claim templates.

name: PostgreSQL
description: How PostgreSQL stores, finds and protects your data.

chapters.title: Indexes & Query Plans
chapters.topic: PostgreSQL indexes and query planning: B-tree, hash, GIN, GiST and BRIN indexes, composite and partial and expression indexes, index-only scans, reading EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE, sequential vs index vs bitmap scans, join algorithms, statistics and ANALYZE.

chapters.title: Transactions & MVCC
chapters.topic: PostgreSQL transactions and concurrency: ACID, MVCC and tuple visibility, isolation levels (read committed, repeatable read, serializable) and their anomalies, row and table locks, deadlocks, SELECT FOR UPDATE, VACUUM, autovacuum and transaction ID wraparound.

chapters.title: Replication & Backups
chapters.topic: PostgreSQL durability and high availability: the write-ahead log, checkpoints, streaming replication and replication slots, synchronous vs asynchronous replicas, logical replication, pg_dump vs pg_basebackup, point-in-time recovery, failover basics.

name: Python asyncio
description: Concurrent Python with asyncio, from the event loop up.

chapters.title: Event Loop & Coroutines
chapters.topic: Python asyncio fundamentals: coroutines and async/await, the event loop, asyncio.run, awaitables (coroutines, Tasks, Futures), how await yields control, blocking calls and run_in_executor / to_thread, why CPU-bound work does not speed up.

chapters.title: Tasks, Cancellation & Timeouts
chapters.topic: Python asyncio tasks: create_task and keeping references, gather vs TaskGroup (3.11+) and exception groups, cancellation and CancelledError handling, shield, timeouts with asyncio.timeout and wait_for, structured concurrency.

chapters.title: Async I/O Patterns
chapters.topic: Python asyncio patterns: asyncio.Queue producer/consumer, Semaphore for rate limiting, Lock and Event, streams (open_connection, start_server), async iterators and async context managers, async generators, common bugs (forgotten await, blocking the loop, unclosed sessions).
